acceptance_criteria: AC-01: When a user navigates to '/car/:id' and clicks the 'Price' tab button, a button with the exact visible text 'Calculate EMI' must appear. Clicking that button must render a modal overlay that contains a heading element with the exact text 'EMI Calculator', a span or element containing the car's brand name matching the API field 'brand' (case-insensitive), a subtitle element matching the pattern /Financial Tool/i, and a price element matching the pattern /Ex-showroom\s*\$<price>/ where <price> is the locale-formatted (en-US) string of the car's 'price' field. All four elements must be visible within 8000 ms of the button click.

AC-02: When the EMI Calculator modal opens, the first input[type='number'] (down payment %) must have the value '20', the second input[type='number'] (interest rate %) must have the value '9.5', and the third input[type='number'] (tenure months) must have the value '36'. These values must be present before any user interaction with the inputs.

AC-03: When the EMI Calculator modal opens for a car with price=$26,750 using the default inputs (down=20%, rate=9.5%, tenure=36 months), the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must contain visible text matching '$5,350' (down payment), '$686' (monthly EMI), and '$21,400' (loan amount). For cars with a price other than $26,750, the result card must contain visible elements with the text labels 'Down Payment', 'Loan Amount', 'Total Interest', and 'Total Cost'.

AC-04: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the first input[type='number'] (down payment %) to '30', the summary strip element located via the selector 'div.bg-slate-950 .flex.flex-wrap' must display a text node matching the pattern /\$<amount>/ where <amount> equals Math.round(0.30 * car.price) formatted with en-US locale separators — within 5000 ms of the input change, without any button click.

AC-05: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the second input[type='number'] (interest rate %) to '7.5', the summary strip element located via the selector 'div.bg-slate-950 .flex.flex-wrap' must contain a visible text node matching the pattern /7\.5% p\.a\./i within 5000 ms of the input change, without any button click.

AC-06: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the third input[type='number'] (tenure months) to '60', the summary strip element located via the selector 'div.bg-slate-950 .flex.flex-wrap' must contain a visible text node matching /60 mo/i and a separate visible text node matching /5 yrs/i within 5000 ms of the input change, without any button click.

AC-07: When the EMI Calculator modal is open for a car with price=$26,750 and the user sets down payment='30', rate='7.5', tenure='60', the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must contain visible text matching '$375' (monthly EMI), '$8,025' (down payment), '$18,725' (loan amount), '$3,775' (total interest), and '$30,525' (total cost) within 5000 ms. For cars with a different price, the element containing '/month' must be visible.

AC-08: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the first input[type='range'] (down payment slider) is set to value 50 via a native InputEvent and change Event on the HTMLInputElement, the first input[type='number'] must display the value '50' within 5000 ms, and a text node matching the pattern /50%\s*·\s*\$<amount>/ where <amount> equals Math.round(0.50 * car.price) formatted with en-US locale separators must be visible in the page within 5000 ms — without any button click.

AC-09: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the second input[type='range'] (interest rate slider) is set to value 12 via a native InputEvent and change Event on the HTMLInputElement, the second input[type='number'] must display the value '12' within 5000 ms, and an element with text '/month' must be visible in the page within 5000 ms.

AC-10: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the third input[type='range'] (tenure slider) is set to value 24 via a native InputEvent and change Event on the HTMLInputElement, the third input[type='number'] must display the value '24' within 5000 ms, and the summary strip element 'div.bg-slate-950 .flex.flex-wrap' must contain a visible text node matching /2 yrs/i within 5000 ms.

AC-11: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the third input[type='number'] (tenure) to '1', the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must contain a visible text node matching /1 Months/i within 5000 ms, and within that same result card a 'div.text-3xl' element must contain text matching /\$\d/ (a dollar sign followed by at least one digit), and an element with text '/month' must be visible in the page.

AC-12: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the third input[type='number'] (tenure) to '360', the summary strip element 'div.bg-slate-950 .flex.flex-wrap' must contain a visible text node matching /30 yrs/i within 5000 ms, and an element with text '/month' must be visible in the page.

AC-13: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the second input[type='number'] (interest rate) to '0', the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must contain a visible element with text 'Total Interest' within 5000 ms, and an element with text '/month' must be visible — the component must handle the zero-rate edge case without crashing or rendering 'NaN'/'Infinity' anywhere in the page body.

AC-14: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the first input[type='number'] (down payment %) to '100', the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must contain a 'div.text-3xl' element with text matching /\$0/ within 5000 ms, and the result card must also contain a visible element with text 'Loan Amount'.

AC-15: When the EMI Calculator modal is open (with any valid inputs), the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must simultaneously contain four visible text labels: the exact strings 'Down Payment', 'Loan Amount', 'Total Interest', and 'Total Cost'.

AC-16: When the EMI Calculator modal is open, the full innerText of the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must contain the '$' character and must not contain the '₹' character.

AC-17: When the EMI Calculator modal is open, the summary strip element 'div.bg-slate-950 .flex.flex-wrap' must contain four visible text nodes matching /Loan:/i, /Rate:/i, /Down:/i, and /Term:/i. When the user subsequently sets the third input[type='number'] (tenure) to '48', the summary strip must contain a visible text node matching /48 mo/i within 5000 ms — without any button click.

AC-18: When the EMI Calculator modal is open for a car with price=$26,750 and the user sets down payment='15.5', rate='11.5', tenure='48', the result card element with CSS classes 'rounded-2xl' and 'border-2' must contain visible text matching '$590' (monthly EMI), '$4,146' (down payment), '$5,716' (total interest), and '$32,466' (total cost) within 5000 ms. For cars with a different price, an element with text '/month' must be visible within 5000 ms.

AC-19: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets tenure to '48' then clicks the button with text 'Proceed to Book →', within 5000 ms the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must not be visible, an element matching 'h2:has-text("Booking")' must be visible within 8000 ms, an element matching text /Selected EMI Plan/i must be visible, and within the element 'div.rounded-xl.bg-white\/10' a text node matching /48 months/i must be visible within 5000 ms.

AC-20: When the user clicks 'Proceed to Book →' from the EMI Calculator modal (with rate='8.5' and tenure='24'), and the booking form is submitted with valid inputs (name min 2 chars, valid email, 10-digit contact number) via the element with id='purchase-submit', the POST request to a URL containing '/api/bookings' must return HTTP status 201 within 15000 ms. If the response body contains a 'booking.emi_details' or 'emi_details' object, that object must have 'opted' equal to boolean true, 'tenure' equal to the integer 24, and 'annualRate' equal to the number 8.5.

AC-21: When the user clicks 'Proceed to Book →' from the EMI Calculator modal (with tenure='36') and the booking modal opens (verified by 'h2:has-text("Booking")' being visible within 8000 ms), the last element matching 'div.bg-white' must contain a visible text node matching /EMI plan/i and a separate visible text node matching /\/mo for 36 months/i within 5000 ms.

AC-22: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user clicks the button matching the selector 'button.absolute.top-6.right-6' (with force:true), within 5000 ms the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must not be visible, the page URL must still match the pattern /\/car\//, and a button element with accessible name 'Price' must be visible.

AC-23: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user clicks the element matching the selector 'div.fixed.inset-0.z-\[200\]' at position {x:10, y:10} with force:true, within 5000 ms the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must not be visible.

AC-24: When the user navigates to the detail page of a car with condition='Used' and availability_status='Available' (fetched from GET /api/cars), clicks the 'Price' tab, then clicks 'Calculate EMI', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must be visible within 8000 ms. The page must contain exactly 3 elements matching 'input[type="number"]', exactly 3 elements matching 'input[type="range"]', a visible element with text 'Proceed to Book →', and a visible element with text 'Your EMI Breakdown'.

AC-25: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the third input[type='number'] (tenure) to '18', the summary strip element 'div.bg-slate-950 .flex.flex-wrap' must contain a visible text node matching /1\.5 yrs/i within 5000 ms, and an element with text '/month' must be visible in the page.

AC-26: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the third input[type='number'] (tenure) to '0', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible within 3000 ms, the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'TypeError', and the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'NaN'.

AC-27: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user sets the third input[type='number'] (tenure) with the value '-5', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible, and the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'NaN'.

AC-28: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user fills the third input[type='number'] (tenure) with the value '361', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible, and the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'NaN'.

AC-29: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user fills the first input[type='number'] (down payment %) with the value '101', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible, the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'NaN', and the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'Infinity'.

AC-30: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user fills the first input[type='number'] (down payment %) with the value '-10', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible, and the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'NaN'.

AC-31: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user fills the second input[type='number'] (interest rate %) with the value '101', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible, the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'NaN', and the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'Infinity'.

AC-32: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user activates the third input[type='number'] (tenure) and types the characters 'abc' via keyboard (not via fill()), the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible and an element with text 'Your EMI Breakdown' must be visible.

AC-33: When a user navigates to '/car/:id' and the car detail page is rendered (the loading text matching /Scanning vehicle signatures/i is no longer visible within 15000 ms), and the user does not click the 'Price' tab, then no element with text 'Calculate EMI' must be visible, and no element with text 'EMI Calculator' must be visible.

AC-34: When the user clicks 'Proceed to Book →' from the EMI Calculator modal and the booking modal opens (verified by 'h2:has-text("Booking")' being visible within 8000 ms), and then the user either clicks the first element matching 'div.bg-white button.absolute' (if visible) or clicks the first element matching 'div.fixed.inset-0.z-\[100\]' at position {x:10, y:10} with force:true, within 5000 ms the element 'h2:has-text("Booking")' must not be visible, and the page URL must still match the pattern /\/car\//.  No POST request to '/api/bookings' must have been made during this flow.

AC-35: When the EMI Calculator modal is open and the user fills the second input[type='number'] (interest rate %) with the value '99.9', the element with text 'EMI Calculator' must remain visible, the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'NaN', the page body's text content must not contain the substring 'Infinity', and an element with text '/month' must be visible.

AC-36: When the user clicks 'Proceed to Book →' from the EMI Calculator modal, the booking modal opens (verified by 'h2:has-text("Booking")' being visible within 8000 ms), and the user fills the element with id='purchase-name' with a single character 'A', fills the element with id='purchase-email' with a valid email, fills the element with id='purchase-contact' with '9876543210', then clicks the element with id='purchase-submit', a toast or alert element must appear within 8000 ms containing the exact text 'Please enter a valid full name (min 2 characters)' (case-insensitive match) and no POST request to '/api/bookings' must return a 2xx response.
